name: Constructor University
description: Constructor University (previously known as Jacobs University Bremen) is a private, residential, and multinational university situated in Vegesack, Bremen, Germany. It provides undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs in engineering, humanities, natural sciences, and social sciences. English is the primary language of instruction at the institution. More than 110 different nations are represented among Constructor University's student body, with about 80% of them being foreigners and about 33% of the staff being from other countries. From its mission statement, Constructor University has deduced three key goals for its educational profile academic excellence, individual development and employability.
